settings.name: browser.linkClick
settings.title: Open a link you click
settings.description: Where a link you click in the app opens. Ctrl+click, Cmd+click on macOS, opens it in the other place.

settings.name: browser.linkMiddleClick
settings.title: Middle-click a link
settings.description: Whether a middle click on a link opens it like Ctrl+click, Cmd+click on macOS, or like a click.

settings.name: browser.systemSites
settings.title: Always open in your browser
settings.description: Sites whose links always open in your browser, such as those you're signed in to there: hosts separated by commas, such as github.com, each with its subdomains.

settings.name: browser.agentTools
settings.title: Let agents use the browser
settings.description: Whether agents can open, read and act on pages with the browser's tools. While it's off, each of their calls is refused before it asks you anything or touches a page.

settings.name: browser.localSites
settings.title: Sites on this computer or network
settings.description: Sites on this computer or its network that you and agents may open, such as a development server: their addresses with http:// or https://, as localhost or an IP address, and no path, separated by commas, such as http://127.0.0.1:4173. No other address on this computer or network opens.
